reason: Reviewed all five surfaces for named folder Projects. Outside a Git repository, a folder the User registered with `notifai project folder add <path> --name <name>` (or any folder inside it) now supplies the Project; a Git repository inside it keeps its own, and explicit, configured and --projectless choices still win. Notifai skill: the setup section now names the command for when the User asks to make a plain folder a Project, beside the per-project enable/disable switch; the release note says the same. Lifecycle hooks: SessionStart guidance and Project Enablement follow the inferred folder Project for descendant folders (covered by the change's tests); hook wording is unchanged. CLI readiness: doctor and project status report the folder Project the same way as an inferred Git Project; no new readiness state. Harness setup and domain terms: unchanged (a Project is still the Account-owned identity; only its inference source widened). Reconciled response schema validation with current main, preserving current optional protocol fields and additive output metadata. Reviewed all five surfaces for the host-neutral terminal step. CLI readiness: where Codex runs under an app with no hook review of its own, the reminder (doctor's and a refused ask's user_action.message, and the once-per-thread send notice), the init warning and the done message now say "in a terminal on this machine" for every such app; the T3 Code-only parenthetical "(T3 Code's terminal panel works)" is gone. Which places get a terminal step is unchanged (an app host or a separate Codex home), the command is still `notifai doctor codex`, Orca's wording and note are unchanged, and hooks that are off still say to type /hooks. Lifecycle hooks: no hook definition or output changes. Notifai skill: references/harness-codex.md already names the command without any app; no change. Harness setup: docs/HARNESSES.md already gives the generic step and names T3 Code and Orca only as examples of apps without a hook review; no change. Domain terms: unchanged. skills/guidance-changes.json carries one new note for this change. Combined with open retained-content, feature, Account preference, registration and send-confirmation response guards: older retained values, additive fields and questionless content remain accepted; submission rules and User decisions are unchanged. These guard additions require no extra wording on lifecycle hooks, the Notifai skill, harness setup, CLI readiness or domain terms.
